goal: Document and enforce release acceptance criteria: least-privilege GitHub Actions, input/output validation, asset rights, security, versioned rollback and no accidental publishing. First department contribution: design/release/release-quality-gates.md. Stay within this single file and report any missing cross-department contracts rather than changing someone else's module.
acceptance: Manual review boundaries, secrets never in generated code, rollback checklist
Exact target file design/release/release-quality-gates.md validates and is independently reviewed
No new third-party binary art or audio, untracked API secrets or unreviewed contracts
